name: gnomon-cli
description: Gnomon desktop CLI: validate a brain, regenerate its indexes, show status. Run as `npx gnomon-cli <command>` in a brain.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --define:__GNOMON_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" --outfile=dist/gnomon.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
